audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The explicit minimax lower bound exceeds its valid scope; The S=1 upper proof uses a false variance identity; Algorithm 3 admits linear regret.
limitations: 0098-P1 — Counterevidence: Full-set intent avoids singleton only; fixed-dimension asymptotics avoid growing-K family but weaken uniform theorem
0098-P2 — Counterevidence: Feasible-target proof identity; reachability not established; zero actual regret in example
0098-P3 — Counterevidence: Other companion choices can succeed; not every variant fails

0098-N1 — Counterevidence: Fixed-comparator and oblivious deterministic-sequence scope avoids the selected-comparator bias. A different uniform or martingale proof may recover the bound; no numerical rate counterexample is claimed.

0098-L1 — Counterevidence: The one-sided reward difference remains <=(K-S)epsilon<=K epsilon, proven directly by positive mass and rewards in [0,1]. Thus this finding does not falsify the numerical rate. Local repairability does not remove the operative derivation error under the supplied calibration.

proposition.claim:
Any subset and uniform T>=max(S,alpha^3/S), S<=K/2 gives Omega(S sqrt(T log(K/S))+sqrt(alpha S T))

Squared centered gain is weighted second moment minus m^2

Sublinear stochastic guarantee for arbitrary decision subset

An expected bound established for each comparator fixed before estimator averaging is concluded as an E[max] hindsight bound against nonanticipating adaptive rewards.

The minimizing truncated comparator satisfies ||v-v_epsilon||_1 <= K epsilon, used to obtain the epsilon K T term in Eq.(7).
